# Band Nyx (Band Nyx Vijayawada)

> Band Nyx is a professional live band based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, performing high-energy rock, pop, Telugu and English music for concerts, events, weddings and private shows.

## Canonical facts

- **Band name:** Band Nyx (use full name; avoid bare "NYX" alone)
- **Also known as:** Band Nyx Vijayawada, Band Nyx Andhra Pradesh
- **Primary website:** https://band-nyx.vercel.app/
- **Mirror:** https://vishanthlynn.github.io/bandNyx/
- **Location:** Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Established:** 2026
- **Genre / style:** Rock, pop, melody, high-energy live band — Telugu, Hindi and English
- **Lineup:** Six-piece (Murali, Bidit, Vishanth, Justin, Charan, Prasanna)
- **Cities performed:** Vijayawada, Guntur, Hyderabad, Tirupati, Charlotte USA
- **Band Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/band.nyx/ (@band.nyx)
- **Booking phone:** +91 79950 22614, +91 90597 53108
- **Founder and manager:** Vishanth — https://www.instagram.com/lynnvishanth/ (@lynnvishanth)
